answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 63153 Country: OM Title: Meeras Question: My father has expired, and I have 1 mother, 1 sister, 2 brothers including me. We sold 1 land that was in my father’s name for 12 lacs. How much share each 1 of us will get? Answer ID: 63153 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 250/250/M=03/1437) In the question mentioned above, all the property of your deceased father including 12 lakhs rupees shall be divided into 40 shares. Out of the total your mother shall get 5 shares, 14-14 shares shall go to each brother while your sister shall get 7 shares. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x05 = 05 Sons: 2x14 = 28 Daughter: 1x07 = 07 Total: 40 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
